not_authorized: no allocation is requested or released; no compute is launched; historical allocation balances are not carried forward
formula: total = setup + development + N_experiments * per_experiment + independent_verification + retry_allowance; admitted = total / (1 - 0.20)

inputs.provenance_of_counts: B's assurance.py criteria (f19084f4: kappa [0.80, 1.25], beta 0.10, alpha 0.04 coverage / 0.01 bias) rerun by C with n_functionals = 4 x 206 = 824: N_required 823, N_design 1250 per case; B's single-case values 719 / 1116 reproduce at 206

ki84_rebuild.workload: production 2D bootstrap replica: unfold_2d_omnifold_unbinned.py --iters 5 --use-weights --estimator lgbm --bootstrap-seed N --seed 1 (sbatch_ki84_replicas.sh), CV omnifile

ki85_diag.workload: fixed-truth pseudo-data toy: coverage_fixed_truth/fixed_truth_toy.py --iters 5 --estimator lgbm --seed 1 (sbatch_ki85_arms.sh, 64 CPUs)

vl169_coverage.workload: fixed-truth closure toy with MC bootstrap stream (sbatch_fixed_truth_toys.sh, 128 CPUs) and equivalence runs

c_cv_unfold.why: production replica workload, shared 64 CPUs, n=300

c_universe_unfold.why: shared rate x documented universe/CV wall ratio 2.239 (119 GB universe omnifile I/O); universe unfolds at 64 CPUs are unmeasured

retry_rate.why: about 3x the measured 0-failure CP95 upper bound

c_universe_unfold.why: ~30 min per universe task on a full node, no receipt

retry_rate.why: time-limit losses as seen in larger campaigns

optimistic.what: identity-carrying event-loop rebuild with universe columns (B's R0, needed by every independent-population option): 12 playlists at the full-universe loop's 8 CPU / 48G request (billing 24 ASSUMED); optimistic 2.5 h per task (documented vertical-universe maximum), conservative the 24 h time limit
optimistic.reusable_because: event identity and universe weights do not depend on any experiment

optimistic.what: matched systematic sweep at the central estimator's seed/backend (187 universes + matched CV)
optimistic.reusable_because: deltas depend on the MC model, not on a single experiment, once the central recipe is fixed (valid only for P2/P3; P1 recomputes)

optimistic.what: selection-complete lateral support: reuse 5D active-universe event loops (optimistic) or rerun 120 per-playlist loops (conservative ceiling: 120 x 5 h x 8/256), then 10 lateral unfolds
optimistic.reusable_because: event-level support does not depend on the experiment's data draw

optimistic.what: continuous lateral nuisance generator (relaxed-selection event pass with shifted muon kinematics)
optimistic.reusable_because: per-event shift vectors are experiment independent

optimistic.what: background-template statistics: analytic sum-w2 bound (optimistic) or a 300-replica rebuild with a background stream
optimistic.reusable_because: template statistics are fixed MC populations

optimistic.what: bootstrap x estimator-seed factorial (50 replicas x 4 seeds)
optimistic.reusable_because: measures the overlap of two blocks at the central recipe

optimistic.what: model-allowance calibration: 3 development truths x 200 fixed-band experiments + 2 expectation runs each
optimistic.reusable_because: B is frozen before validation and does not depend on validation data
